name: agent-office
description: Local-first pixel-art office that visualizes real Claude Code sessions, subagents and teammates from lifecycle hooks.
author: JonathanClintonW

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent-office/ui && npm run build -w @agent-office/monitor && npm run build -w agent-office-vscode
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/monitor --noEmit && tsc -p packages/ui --noEmit && tsc -p packages/vscode-extension --noEmit
scripts.package:vsix: npm run build && npm run package -w agent-office-vscode
